title: Mastering tcpdump: Port Ranges & Packet Analysis Pipelines
short_hook: Master tcpdump filters to capture only the traffic you need.
description:
Learn tcpdump advanced BPF filters, port ranges, and packet analysis pipelines to master network traffic analysis. In this lesson: - Understand BPF syntax and logic - Use port ranges for web traffic filtering - Combine conditions with AND, OR, NOT - Build efficient capture pipelines - Avoid common filtering pitfalls This is lesson 44 of our complete Kali Linux Tools Hands-On course - watch the full playlist from the beginning. Ask your doubts about BPF syntax in the comments below.
